step2_negative_validation.rca_note: Two distinct validation gates exist: (a) canProceedToStep(3) at Step2→Step3 transition with message 'Please enter at least one process name' (existing legacy guard, fires FIRST), and (b) c1ActiveModule.validateCreateSubmission at submit time with message 'At least one Name of Process is required' (NEW Phase C module code at /app/frontend/src/components/EmissionEntryForm.js line 3879-3888). Because (a) fires earlier in the wizard, (b) is effectively unreachable in normal UI flow. Functionally safe (user cannot bypass), but the module-owned validation in (b) is dead code under current step gating. Main agent should decide: either (1) accept this as defense-in-depth, or (2) align the wording of the legacy canProceedToStep guard to the module's expected message for forward-consistency, or (3) explicitly document that module validateCreateSubmission only fires when canProceedToStep is bypassed (e.g., via direct submit shortcut).
